verdict.line: You lose if you walk into Aatrox's Q1-E-Q2 poke chain and let him kite it into a solo kill before level 6; you win the 51% (902 games) where you deny his E charges and close with your own combo once R (Noxian Guillotine) is up.

brief.thesis: This is a genuinely even lane by the numbers (51% over 902 games) but the solo-kill lean sits with Aatrox because his kit is built to poke from range and disengage — Q (Darkin Blade) extends his hitbox each cast and E (Umbral Dash) both closes and escapes on a 2-charge system. Darius has no ranged poke of his own; every trade requires him to walk into Aatrox's Q-E threat range, so the matchup is decided by whether Darius fights on Aatrox's E cooldown or on his own.

theirWindow.when: both E charges up, Q maxed by level 3
theirWindow.what: Aatrox can dash in, land Q1-Q2, and dash back out before you can punish — hold your trades to short exchanges next to minions and don't chase the second dash.

yourWindow.when: Aatrox has just burned both E charges
yourWindow.what: The ~9-11s recharge window is when he has no gap-close or escape — flash-less E (Apprehend) to pull him in, stack Hemorrhage with autos and W (Crippling Strike), and commit fully.

start.why: The extra sustain absorbs chip damage from Aatrox's Q pokes while you wait out his E cooldown, and the AD keeps your short trades relevant (50.5% WR over 901 games, 82.3% pick).

boots.why: Aatrox's damage is almost entirely physical (Q slams, autos, passive procs), so the flat reduction blunts every poke he lands during the laning phase (51% WR, 78.8% pick).

core.why: The active haste closes the exact gap Aatrox's E dash opens, letting you stick through his disengage instead of losing the fight to kiting.
Momentum from wave movement gives you the burst of speed to catch his second E charge, and the health buffers his passive-fueled extended trades.
Delaying his Q-slam and R burst as damage-over-time lets your own healing and Hemorrhage stacks outpace his lifesteal in extended fights (67.6% WR over 102 games on this path).

situational.when: aatrox is committing hard all-ins around his level 6 or 11 power spikes and you need the shield to survive his R (World Ender) burst
their team stacks magic damage around Aatrox and you need the MR and tenacity to keep dueling him
aatrox is split-pushing and disengaging repeatedly and you need waveclear plus a slow to shut down his kiting

runes.keystoneWhy: Conqueror stacks over the extended trades this matchup forces, and its healing directly offsets Aatrox's passive lifesteal loop, while the adaptive force scaling helps your R (Noxian Guillotine) execute threshold come online faster.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite runs a 54.2% win rate in this matchup (32.8% pick) versus 49.9% for Flash+Ghost — Ignite denies Aatrox's passive healing on the all-ins you take once his E charges are down, converting your execute-range kills into secured ones.

playing.title: Farm the Q outer edge
playing.detail: Use the far tip of Q (Decimate) to last-hit and heal without stepping into Aatrox's E (Umbral Dash) or Q3 slam range.

playing.title: Count his E charges
playing.detail: Aatrox's Umbral Dash has 2 charges on a shared recharge; once both are spent after a dash-in or reposition, that's your window to commit.

playing.title: Hold trades before level 6
playing.detail: His Q1-2 poke and passive edge give him the solo-kill lean this data shows — keep pre-6 exchanges short and next to minions.

playing.title: All-in off your R spike
playing.detail: Once Noxian Guillotine is up, chain auto, W (Crippling Strike), and E (Apprehend) into R before he stacks passive healing from ability damage.

playing.title: Save Flash for his exit
playing.detail: His last E charge is his only escape from a real all-in — hold Flash to cut off that dash rather than spending it to engage.

playing.title: Pop Ignite on commit
playing.detail: Ignite blunts the bonus healing from his passive on the engage where you're already ahead on Death's Dance sustain, turning close trades into kills.

brief.patchCaveat: Win rates, build order, boots, runes, and summoner spells reflect games measured on the current patch via OP.GG; the tactical reading — E-charge tracking, trade timing, and execute sequencing — is my own analysis on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being hit by Aatrox’s (Q)-(E) combo. Avoid his pokes while closing in to fight him in close quarters.
